question: Ghanakanta Bora Borbayan has been conferred the Padma Shri award for his contribution to which of the following fields?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sattriya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ghanakanta Bora Borbayan** received the **Padma Shri in 2013**.
 
• Awarded for his contributions to** Sattriya dance**.
 
• **Sattriya** is a **classical dance** form from **Assam, India**.
 
• **Borbayan** likely played a significant role in **preserving and promoting Sattriya culture**.
 
• His work possibly includes **teaching, choreography, or cultural advocacy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhortal**

 
 
• **Bhortal** is a traditional **Assamese percussion music form**.
 
• Features rhythmic interplay of instruments like **khol and taal** (cymbals).
 
• Often accompanies traditional** Assamese dances and cultural events**.
 
 
 
• **Bagurumba**
 
 
• Traditional **folk dance **of the **Bodo community **in **Assam**.
 
• Features graceful movements, **vibrant costumes**, and **rhythmic music**.
 
• Often seen at festivals and cultural events celebrating Bodo culture.
 
 
 
• **Chhau**
 
 
• Traditional dance from eastern** India** **(Jharkhand, West Bengal, Odisha)**.
 
• Known for **vibrant costumes**, **elaborate masks**, and **dynamic movements**.
 
• **Includes three styles: Seraikella Chhau**, **Mayurbhanj Chhau**, and **Purulia Chhau**.
